description: Update or annotate an existing memory. Use this when you discover additional context, when a decision changes, or when you want to adjust importance based on new information.

add_tags.description: Add tags without replacing existing ones.

content.description: Updated content. If provided, the embedding vector is regenerated.

expected_revision.description: Reject if the memory changed since this revision.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to update. MUST be the full UUID format (e.g., 8f7cab3b-644e-4cea-8662-de0ca695bdf2), not a shortened version. Use recall to get the full UUID.

project.description: Change the project this memory belongs to (e.g. "my-web-app", "synabun").

supersedes.description: Explicitly mark another memory in this project as superseded by this one.

name: reflect
